sections.title: Dependency list and setup notes
sections.what: Lists three test packages and notes that the Python code needs nothing else. Also explains that Node.js and the shadcn/ui command-line tool are needed for the front-end side.
sections.why: Tells a developer what to install before running tests or building a project with the skill.
sections.watch_out: The shadcn/ui command runs per project, so a developer must run it inside each project that uses the skill.

summary: Dependency list for the UI styling skill, noting that its Python code uses only the standard library and that testing tools are listed as development extras.
purpose: Tells a developer what to install to run the skill's tests and what the front-end tools need.
why: Likely reason: the file lists only test packages because the Python code needs nothing outside the standard library.
how: Install the three test packages with pip. Separately, install Node.js 18 or newer, and set up the shadcn/ui CLI in each project with npx.
inputs: None. It is read by pip and by a person following the setup notes.
outputs: Installed test packages when pip is run on this file.
risks: Versions use minimum bounds only, so a future major release could behave differently. The shadcn/ui setup is not installed by this file.
debug: If tests fail to start, confirm pytest is installed at the listed version. If the front-end setup fails, confirm Node.js and npm are installed.
